Indian Railways Expands Services and Implements Waste Management System

Indian Railways has extended three train services and added new stops to ten existing routes. In a separate development, the railway service has developed a new waste disposal system for trains. This system includes a 367-litre capacity disposal unit designed to manage waste and reduce overflow.
